subject: general
question: A person covers 11 km with a speed of 7 km/h, 25 km with a speed of 10 km/h and 30 km with a speed of 20 km/h. What is the average speed of the person?
solution:
**Given:**

Distance covered at 7 km/h = 11 km

Distance covered at 10 km/h = 25 km

Distance covered at 20 km/h = 30 km

**Formula Used:**

Average speed = Total distance travelled / Total time taken

**Calculation:**

Total Distance = 11 km + 25 km + 30 km

Total Distance = 66 km

Time taken to cover 11 km at 7 km/h = 11 / 7 hours

Time taken to cover 25 km at 10 km/h = 25 / 10 hours

Time taken to cover 30 km at 20 km/h
